title: Completeness of Directed Reachability for NL
statement: Let $\mathrm{PATH}$ be the language of encodings of finite directed graphs with a designated start and target vertex for which the target is reachable from the start. Then $\mathrm{PATH}$ belongs to $\mathrm{NL}$, and every language in $\mathrm{NL}$ has a log-space many-one reduction to $\mathrm{PATH}$. Here $\mathrm{NL}$ is the class of binary languages decidable by a finite nondeterministic Turing machine using space bounded by a constant multiple of $\lfloor\log_2 n\rfloor+1$.
